title: Sorcerer and Runestone
description: A hooded sorcerer in a dark blue cloak stands with his back to the viewer, placing his glowing right hand on a massive cracked runestone. The stone is covered in glowing cyan runes and a black demonic silhouette, with purple lightning striking its top. Offerings of antlers, a bowl with smoke, and scattered bones lie at its base in a misty graveyard surrounded by smaller standing stones under an aurora borealis sky.
prompt: A hooded sorcerer in a flowing dark blue cloak stands with his back mostly to the viewer, reaching out with a glowing right hand to touch a massive ancient cracked runestone. The stone is covered in glowing cyan Nordic runes and features a prominent black demonic horned silhouette. Purple magical lightning strikes the top of the stone. At its base are ritual offerings including deer antlers, a smoking bowl, and scattered bones. The scene takes place in a foggy graveyard with other smaller runestones visible, under a dramatic night sky filled with vibrant green and purple aurora borealis.
